apis.name: gl.Viewport
apis.required_equivalent: Render pipeline/depth-stencil/raster state plus encoder viewport/scissor; preserve per-face stencil and coverage.

limitations: Static Lua lexer/reference inventory, not a complete call graph or runtime frequency measurement.

Single-name local aliases have file-level candidate calls only; multi-assignment aliases, reassignment, lexical shadowing, dynamic dispatch, VFS includes and shader concatenation are not fully resolved.
Stage keys and shader string markers are candidates; configurations/dead/optional code may be included. Shader source concatenation and CheckShaderUpdates variants require runtime tracing.
Sparse absent tracked Lua/shader files are enumerated; external maps/widgets and untracked runtime content are outside scope.
Operation classifications are implementation obligations, not Metal capabilities or evidence of visual equivalence.
scope: All physically present pinned tracked BAR Lua plus supplied official module supplements; official game and engine shader assets. Immutable source records include SHA-256 and pinned Git blob checks.
